success_redirect.description: Where to send the payer after a successful checkout. Must be on the Monid web-app origin. Defaults to the web-app wallet page, so an agent without a UI can omit it and hand the returned `url` to its owner.

cancel_redirect.description: Where to send the user if checkout is cancelled. Must be on the Monid web-app origin.

autoReload.description: Opt in to auto-reload (with the service defaults) when this checkout completes. Opt-in ONLY: the system never enables auto-reload on the caller's behalf, so `false` and an omitted field are equivalent and record nothing. Ignored when auto-reload is already enabled on the wallet.
